title: NFR-010 Cost observability: token, model, tool and cost/run are measured and attributable
risk: AI spend is invisible until the invoice arrives, and no one can attribute cost to a run, a customer or a conversion, so unit economics cannot be managed.
preconditions: Namespace gov-nfr-<case_id>-<worker_id>; NFR verification runs against the offline gateway with mock SoR and channel boundaries.
Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; failure, outage and crash injections are scripted at the substituted boundary, never faked inside the assertion.
The mock model provider returns canned token usage so cost arithmetic is deterministic.

steps.action: Execute one run and read the cost record
steps.expected: The record contains prompt tokens, completion tokens, model identity and a cost_twd value per the audit schema field 17.

steps.action: Recompute the cost from the recorded usage and the pricing configuration
steps.expected: Recomputed cost equals 1200/1000*0.01 + 400/1000*0.02 + 0.002 = 0.022 TWD, matching the stored value.

steps.action: Aggregate cost by run and by customer
steps.expected: Cost per run and cost per customer are both derivable, and the per-customer total equals the sum of that customer's runs.
The displayed figures come from the stored records and are labelled with the measurement source; no target value is substituted.

assertions: Cost is computed from recorded token usage and tool cost, and the arithmetic is reproducible to the stored value.
Cost is attributable at run, customer and tenant level, with sums that reconcile.
No displayed cost is a target, default or estimate presented as measured.
Token counts are the provider-reported values, not local estimates, when the provider reports them.
forbidden: Recording a flat estimated cost per run.
Omitting tool or connector cost so only tokens are counted.
Attributing a customer's cost to a shared pool that cannot be reconciled.
evidence: Cost record for the run with usage and split cost fields.
Aggregation report by run and by customer.
Provider usage payload used as the input.
cleanup: Delete gov- cost rows after export.
automation: Core PEP, rules engine, audit writer, idempotency store and worker lease logic run as real code under test; only ERP/WMS, channel gateways, Redis and the model provider are substituted. Faults are injected at those boundaries and waits are condition-based on persisted state.
note: Generated acceptance specification. Plain specification, not an executable test; no application runtime exists, so the status is NOT_RUN.
